description: Outline or glow around a sprite or every cell of a sprite sheet: pixel-perfect hard outlines for pixel art, antialiased ones for painted art, soft glows for pickups and selection. Cells grow so nothing is cut off. Price: $0.02 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Sprite tools: 2D sprite jobs for games: cut sprites out of their background (exact for one-color backgrounds, AI for busy ones), turn animation videos into aligned sprite sheets, make normal maps for 2D lights, build 47-tile autotile sets with Tiled, Godot and Unity rules, slice a sheet into frames, pack frames into an atlas with TexturePacker and Unity metadata, and turn upscaled or AI-generated pixel art into real pixel art on its true grid with a limited palette..

cols.description: For a sprite sheet: columns of equal cells.

expand.description: Grow each cell by the thickness on every side so the outline is not cut off. Off keeps the size.

image.description: Base64 PNG or WebP with transparency.

rows.description: For a sprite sheet: rows of equal cells.

style.description: pixel: hard edge with rounded corners (thickness 1 is the classic four-neighbour outline); pixel-square: hard edge, square corners; smooth: antialiased; glow: soft falloff.
